title: Animals And Birds 3rd Truth The Unfolding Of Forms And The Tahlel Through The Agreement Of 3 Truths

questions.question: What is the main idea of this passage?
questions.answer: It says that many different living creatures come from similar small beginnings in a very careful and beautiful way, and this points to Allah’s wisdom and power.

questions.question: What kinds of living things does the passage talk about?
questions.answer: It talks about animals.

questions.question: About how many different forms of these creatures are mentioned?
questions.answer: It says there are hundreds of thousands of different forms.

questions.question: What does the passage say these creatures come out from?
questions.answer: They come from eggs and from tiny drops called sperm.

questions.question: How are those eggs and drops described at the start?
questions.answer: They are described as very much alike or nearly alike.

questions.question: Are those starting materials described as endless or limited?
questions.answer: They are limited and countable.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the way the creatures appear?
questions.answer: They appear in an ordered, balanced, and reliable way.

questions.question: Why is it amazing that many different creatures come from similar beginnings?
questions.answer: It is amazing because very similar beginnings produce many very different living beings in a wise and exact way.

questions.question: What comparison is used to show how clear this truth is?
questions.answer: Its truth is described as shining very brightly.

questions.question: What supports this truth according to the passage?
questions.answer: Many proofs and signs support it.

questions.question: How many proofs are mentioned?
questions.answer: The passage says they are as many as the animals themselves.

questions.question: What event is being described in this passage?
questions.answer: The passage describes the appearance of countless animals in many different forms.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the source of animal variety?
questions.answer: It teaches that the great variety in animals comes about with wisdom, order, and purpose.

questions.question: Which two beginnings of animal life are named?
questions.answer: Eggs and sperm are named.

questions.question: How are those beginnings alike?
questions.answer: They look the same or almost the same.

questions.question: What is surprising about the creatures that come from them?
questions.answer: Even though the beginnings are similar, the creatures turn out very different from one another.

questions.question: Which words in the passage show that this process is not messy or random?
questions.answer: It says the process is orderly, balanced, and does not fail.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention that the eggs and drops are limited in number?
questions.answer: It shows that from a set number of simple beginnings, many living creatures are formed in a controlled way.

questions.question: What does calling each creature a “miracle of wisdom” help the reader understand?
questions.answer: It helps the reader understand that each animal is made with great care and wise design.

questions.question: What does the passage want the reader to notice when looking at animals?
questions.answer: It wants the reader to notice the order, beauty, and wise planning in their creation.

questions.question: What is the “truth” being talked about in this passage?
questions.answer: The truth is that countless animals come into life in many forms from similar tiny beginnings in a very exact way.

questions.question: What word shows that the number of creatures is extremely large?
questions.answer: The word “countless” shows that.

questions.question: How many kinds of shapes and forms are mentioned?
questions.answer: The passage mentions hundreds of thousands of them.

questions.question: What are two examples of the creatures’ simple starting points?
questions.answer: One example is eggs, and the other is tiny drops of sperm.

questions.question: Do these starting points look very different from one another or mostly alike?
questions.answer: They look mostly alike.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the order of their coming into life?
questions.answer: It says their coming into life happens with excellent order.

questions.question: Besides order, what two other qualities are named?
questions.answer: Balance and reliability are also named.

questions.question: Why might the passage call each creature a “miracle of wisdom”?
questions.answer: Because each one is made in a wonderful and meaningful way.

questions.question: What image is used to show that this truth is very clear?
questions.answer: The passage uses the image of brightness and shining.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the number of evidences for this truth?
questions.answer: It says the evidences are as many as the animals.

questions.question: According to the passage, what comes forth in many different forms?
questions.answer: Living creatures come forth in many different forms.

questions.question: How are these creatures described before their forms are mentioned?
questions.answer: They are described as too many to count.

questions.question: What special value is given to each creature?
questions.answer: Each one is described as showing wise creation in a wonderful way.

questions.question: From what small beginnings do these creatures develop?
questions.answer: They develop from eggs and tiny life drops.

questions.question: What is important about those small beginnings?
questions.answer: They are very similar even though they lead to many different creatures.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the number of those beginnings?
questions.answer: It says they are limited in number.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the process of development?
questions.answer: It describes it as neat, balanced, and always working properly.

questions.question: What proves this truth in the passage?
questions.answer: The animals themselves are signs and proofs of it.

questions.question: What is one big sign in the passage about the creation of animals?
questions.answer: One big sign is that many kinds of animals come from similar small beginnings in a perfectly ordered way.

questions.question: How many animal forms are mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: It mentions hundreds of thousands of forms.

questions.question: What are the two physical beginnings named for these creatures?
questions.answer: The two beginnings are eggs and sperm drops.

questions.question: How are those two beginnings described compared with one another?
questions.answer: They are described as the same or almost the same.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the number of these beginnings?
questions.answer: It says they are limited and not endless.

questions.question: What matches the number of the proofs in the passage?
questions.answer: The number of proofs matches the number of the animals.

questions.question: What does the passage ask the reader to notice about animals?
questions.answer: It asks the reader to notice how many kinds there are and how carefully they are brought into life.

questions.question: Are the creatures in the passage few in number or beyond easy counting?
questions.answer: They are beyond easy counting.

questions.question: What phrase shows that the animals are not all the same?
questions.answer: The passage says they have many different shapes and forms.

questions.question: What do these many creatures begin from?
questions.answer: They begin from eggs and tiny reproductive drops.

questions.question: How similar are those beginnings?
questions.answer: They are identical or very close in likeness.

questions.question: What does the passage say about how many of those beginnings there are?
questions.answer: It says their number is limited.

questions.question: In what manner do the creatures come out from those beginnings?
questions.answer: They come out in a way that is ordered, balanced, and without failure.

questions.question: Why is the result more amazing because the beginnings are alike?
questions.answer: Because from nearly the same starting points, many very different living beings appear.

questions.question: Where are the proofs for this truth seen?
questions.answer: They are seen in the animals themselves.
